title: AS2: 'protected' access modifier silently dropped (not in keyword list)
description: 'protected' is not in AS2_KEYWORDS in the tokenizer, so it is emitted as an identifier token. parseClassMember sees an unknown identifier and skips past it (the 'Unknown token — skip' path), then parses the following var/function declaration on the next iteration with access=null. No error or warning is emitted. Fix: add 'protected' to AS2_KEYWORDS and handle it in parseClassMember the same way 'public'/'private' are handled — as an access modifier that is stripped (AVM1 ignores access modifiers). Location: packages/core/src/as2/tokenizer.ts line ~22 and packages/core/src/as2/parser.ts line ~331.
